field_principles.cold_replay_hashes: A fresh process must reproduce each order and aggregate row hash.
field_principles.constraint_routing_stream_ready: All opportunity, isolation, replay, and headroom gates must pass.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time shows that row generation and replay executed.
field_principles.event_count_by_order: Counts prove every order contains the complete event set.
field_principles.experiment_id: A stable ID binds the artifact to its owned producer.
field_principles.feature_allowlist: Only these current fields may select a live route.
field_principles.feature_denylist: Exact, future, and order fields stay outside action inputs.
field_principles.field_principles: Each required field states the evidence boundary it protects.
field_principles.frozen_manifest: The manifest freezes events and hidden receipts before replay.
field_principles.frozen_policy_metrics_by_order: Frozen row outcomes establish a nonzero live floor.
field_principles.future_feature_violations: An empty list proves action observations passed the denylist audit.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every gate keeps its expected and observed value.
field_principles.held_future_counts: Counts prove each order reaches novel held topology.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix reports completion and the no-gain boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The CPU declaration prevents fixture evidence from becoming an LLM claim.
field_principles.order_definitions: Five hashes freeze chronology before any action receipt opens.
field_principles.poison_counts: Counts prove unsafe reward conflicts are present in every order.
field_principles.random_route_metrics_by_order: Seeded random actions provide a weaker route baseline.
field_principles.random_seed: One seed fixes order shuffles and random-route actions.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable hash detects stream or metric drift.
field_principles.reusable_motif_counts: Counts prove prior visible motifs can inform later actions.
field_principles.route_definitions: Named costs prove live checking is bounded below exhaustive work.
field_principles.rows: One event-order row preserves pre-action and post-action separation.
field_principles.run_date: The fixed execution date prevents silent protocol drift.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema makes incompatible stream readers fail closed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hash: The exact Exp6786 bytes bind every derived event.
field_principles.status: A terminal status separates readiness from a complete block.
field_principles.topology_count_by_order: Counts expose topology coverage in every replicate.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class keeps readiness distinct from a learning-gain claim.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False separates the route policy from exact labeling authority.

honest_verdict: complete: chronological constraint-routing stream ready with 240 events, five orders, held-future isolation, poison, and non-saturated headroom; this is not an online-learning gain claim
inference_substrate: CPU exact chronological decision fixture, no LLM

dependency_suffix.description: Inspect the last three cross-group dependencies.

exhaustive_oracle_diagnostic.description: Inspect every factor after action for diagnostic headroom only.

local_prefix.description: Inspect the first three local constraint groups.

local_suffix.description: Inspect the last three local constraint groups.

mixed_boundary.description: Inspect the first local group and both dependency boundaries.
